groups.title: Petrochemical
groups.summary: Grassroots units, expansions and tie-ins inside operating petrochemical plants along the Houston Ship Channel.
groups.intro: Petrochemical work is the heart of the Gulf Coast district. PCL executes most of the scope with its own crews, from the foundations up through the pipe racks, process equipment and the instrumentation that brings a unit online. Working brownfield inside a running plant is the normal condition rather than the exception.
groups.imageAlt: A petrochemical processing unit with pipe racks and steel structure

services.title: Civil and Foundations
services.text: Site civil work and the concrete foundations under process units, tanks, compressors and pipe racks, self-performed by PCL crews.

services.title: Structural Steel Erection
services.text: Structural steel erection for process structures, pipe racks and equipment supports.

services.title: Piping
services.text: Process and utility piping installed and welded in the field, backed by more than 600 welding procedures developed in-house.
points: Weld repair rate consistently below the industry average

services.title: Process Equipment Installation

services.title: Electrical and Instrumentation

about.title: A self-perform heavy industrial contractor, with Deer Park on the Gulf Coast.
text: PCL Industrial Construction Co. focuses on the heavy industrial market across the United States. We are a diversified, full-service heavy industrial contractor focused on safety, quality and excellence. We self-perform 85% of our work to consistently deliver predictable outcomes for our clients. Our offices and training centers are strategically located in Katy, Deer Park, Port Lavaca and Lake Charles to better serve our clients and capitalize on the availability of experienced staff and craft labor forces.

We bring our construction expertise to a wide spectrum of industrial and manufacturing facilities across North American brownfield and greenfield environments. As a self-perform general contractor, PCL executes most of our work, including civil/foundations, structural steel erection, process equipment installation, piping, electrical, and instrumentation.
about.imageAlt: A Gulf Coast industrial plant project under construction

values.title: Build it Right, Build it Once
values.text: PCL's quality mantra, and the reason quality experts sit with the site execution team rather than apart from it.

values.title: 85% self-performed
values.text: Most of the work is executed by PCL's own crews, which is how outcomes stay predictable.

values.title: Safety, quality and excellence
values.text: The three things the industrial group is built around, on every brownfield and greenfield site.

facts.heading: Experience
facts.text: With almost 80 years of experience, PCL can safely and successfully construct projects of any size, and the company has a 50-year history of dependability as a trusted construction partner for the oil and gas sector.

facts.heading: Quality
facts.text: PCL's quality mantra, 'Build it Right, Build it Once', embodies our focus on delivering quality projects for our clients. More than 600 welding procedures have been developed in-house, and the weld repair rate is consistently below 1.5%, below the industry average. Quality experts partner with the on-site project execution team so client specifications and industry standards are met or exceeded throughout the project's lifecycle.

facts.heading: Project sizes
facts.text: Oil and gas work is executed on projects from less than a million to multiple billions of dollars, with construction solutions tailored to match what a client needs.

facts.heading: Planning and modular construction
facts.text: PCL optimizes front-end constructability, modularization, budgeting and scheduling, and its patented, award-winning HeviLift planning suite gives owners a detailed look into project planning and the optimization of the heavy lift program. As a North American modular construction leader, PCL works with clients to maximize offsite construction, reduce congestion and lower costs.

facts.heading: Training programs
facts.text: PCL offers award-winning training programs to develop employees to succeed in their careers, through Frontline Supervisory Training, NCCER Training and the PCL Certified Craft Program.
